user.title: Connect to Cabanga
user.description: Paste the refresh_token captured manually from the browser DevTools (see README). Each student carries its own school ID, format: school:id:Name, school:id:Name (e.g. {students_example}).

reauth_confirm.title: Cabanga session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The refresh_token is no longer valid. Capture a new one via DevTools (see README) and paste it below. Existing student configuration is kept.

error.invalid_refresh_token: Invalid or expired refresh token. Capture a new one via DevTools.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cabanga API.
